ToonTastic - Beach Props Pack 1.0 — Akduman
https://assetstore.unity.com/packages/3d/props/exterior/toontastic-beach-props-pack-309713
Uses the original beach umbrella prefab, FBX, palette texture/material and
ThirdPartyNotices.txt. The selected C umbrella retains the supplied orange/ivory
canopy profile and pole. Full model height is normalized to 2.36 m.
Fixed cantilever shelters keep their offset supports and original footprint.
Actual canopy geometry provides shadows; placement bounds follow the canopy.

Acquired 2026-11-09. Standard Unity Asset Store EULA:
https://unity.com/legal/as-terms
Original asset hashes and source paths are recorded in the imported package's
source.json. Source asset bytes are retained; Unity import settings and generated
rendering assets are adapted for Built-in rendering. The source FBX also contains
other beach props; only the umbrella is extracted or instantiated by this change.
